title: Acyclic resolved Module capability dependencies
statement: The Fortress Module dependency graph derived from resolved required capabilities MUST NOT contain a directed cycle.
rationale: A cycle prevents a stable dependency direction, obscures impact boundaries, and indicates that the participating responsibilities must be separated or deliberately modeled as one component.
failure_prevented: Mutually dependent architectural components that cannot be ordered, independently reasoned about, or safely invalidated for downstream certification.
applicability: Every resolved Module Contract v2 ecosystem containing functional capability requirements.
evaluation: The Fortress core resolves each required capability to its exact provider Module, derives one functional dependency edge, then performs deterministic graph traversal and emits a canonical finding when a back-edge closes a dependency cycle.

finding.message: Resolved Module capability dependency graph contains a cycle.

remediation: Separate responsibilities to restore one-way dependency flow or model a genuinely inseparable strongly connected cluster as one component. A temporary exception requires a governed transition or exemption.
valid_example: TF-CLI-0001 depends on AF-CORE-0001, while AF-CORE-0001 has no dependency on TF-CLI-0001.
invalid_example: AF-A depends on AF-B and AF-B depends on AF-A.
exception_policy: A bounded transition or explicit exemption may describe a temporary cycle, its owner, scope, and retirement evidence; the affected scope remains not certified until the cycle is removed or the model is legitimately consolidated.
history: Introduced during CHG-ARCHITECTURE-0004 after deterministic repository observation became available.
Finding evidence migrated to the shared content-addressed Snapshot Governance finding contract during CHG-SNAPSHOT-0006 without changing rule meaning.
Dependency authority migrated from the centralized architecture manifest to resolved Module Contract v2 capability requirements.
